definitions.explanation: A freezer appliance or the freezer section of a refrigerator. Used for storing frozen food.

examples.japanese: アイスは{冷凍庫|れいとうこ}に{入|い}れて。
examples.english: Put the ice cream in the freezer.

examples.japanese: {冷凍庫|れいとうこ}がいっぱいで{入|はい}らない。
examples.english: The freezer is full and nothing else fits.

examples.japanese: {残|のこ}った{肉|にく}は{冷凍庫|れいとうこ}で{保存|ほぞん}すれば{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}ほど{持|も}つ。
examples.english: If you store the leftover meat in the freezer, it will keep for about a month.

notes:
Part of a set of related appliance terms: {冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ} (refrigerator), {冷凍庫|れいとうこ} (freezer), {冷凍室|れいとうしつ} (freezer compartment). Many Japanese refrigerators have a separate {冷凍室|れいとうしつ} drawer, distinct from a standalone {冷凍庫|れいとうこ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷凍庫|れいとうこ}に{入|い}れる (to put in the freezer)
- {冷凍庫|れいとうこ}から{出|だ}す (to take out of the freezer)
- {冷凍庫|れいとうこ}で{保存|ほぞん}する (to store in the freezer)
